meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会生成具有独特视觉风格的前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React 等），注重排版、色彩、动效和布局，避免常见的 AI 设计套路。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建网页组件、页面或应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个复古未来风格的登录页面。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应风格的 HTML/CSS 代码。

say.text: 用 React 做一个极简主义的个人作品集首页。
say.note: Claude 会输出 React 组件代码。

howto.what_en: Claude generates frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, etc.) with distinctive visual styles, focusing on typography, color, motion, and layout, avoiding generic AI aesthetics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications.

say_en.text: Design a retro-futuristic login page for me.
say_en.note: Claude will generate HTML/CSS code in that style.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist portfolio homepage using React.
say_en.note: Claude will output React component code.
